name: Amazon frontier, Novo Progresso (PA)
selection: Representative 1 km tropical forest cell near Novo Progresso, Para, Brazil (BR-163 frontier). Not a carbon project. Hansen GFC records 2024 tree-cover loss in about half of it.
boundary_source: Cell chosen by the CanopyProof authors from Hansen GFC; no project boundary

project.name: Representative Amazon frontier cell
project.type: Representative REDD+-style forest area (not a real project)

credit_batch.label: Illustrative REDD+ batch
credit_batch.issued_note: Illustrative amount for a demonstration batch.
credit_batch.monitoring_months_note: Amazon dry season, when clear Sentinel-2 views exist (and when fires occur).
